table.description: ServiceNow ticket table: incident, change_request, problem or sc_task (catalog task).

record_id.description: Optional. For change_request, the change sys_id or number (for example CHG0030002) to list the states that change can move to next. Other tables always return all state choices.

field.description: Optional. A choice field of the table to list the valid values of instead of the states, for example close_code (the resolution code needed to resolve an incident). Values differ per instance, so read them here instead of guessing.
